Vlaga je 83 % — veš se teško suši napolju.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Borča tops PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 again in SEPA's latest labelled hour [F4][F6][F8]. NO2 moved most, its highest value going from 30 to 52 µg/m³ [F7], but that hour's true time is probably 05:00 UTC [F3], so it may be earlier than this Thursday's 07:21 [F1]. Observer's VMA figure is stale: Parking Servis now shows displayed free spaces there moving from 414 to 502 [F12], still with no measurement time [F11].
